import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution11_Variant1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        
        if (w < 4) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }
        
        while (m > 0) {
            int remainder = m % w;
            if (remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1) {
                System.out.println("NO");
                return;
            }
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        }
        
        System.out.println("YES");
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution11_Variant4 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int w = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        
        String result = computeResult(w, m);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
    
    private static String computeResult(int w, int m) {
        if (w < 4) {
            return "YES";
        }
        
        while (m > 0) {
            int remainder = m % w;
            if (isInvalidRemainder(remainder, w)) {
                return "NO";
            }
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        }
        
        return "YES";
    }
    
    private static boolean isInvalidRemainder(int remainder, int w) {
        return remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1;
    }
}
